history_summary: Record five GTDB reference correspondences for the selected Sorghum SRC2v4 descriptors.
history_details: The exact pinned crosswalk supports five selected GTDB blocks and grounding statuses while preserving all fifteen source stocks, original NCBI terms, eight existing blocks, two unresolved descriptors, original notes and quotations, three community observations without arrows, and prior history. PH2 has an Enterobacter ludwigii reference population of 296 genomes and rounded fraction 0.95; SAI_226 has Kribbella shirazensis 3 and fraction 1.0; SO6a has the explicit Acinetobacter genus population 21984 of 21984; NA8 uses the species-name fallback to Pseudomonas_E entomophila with 2 genomes and fraction 1.0; TBS_030 uses the species-name fallback to Chryseobacterium gleum with 2 genomes and fraction 1.0. Species totals and rounded fractions do not supply an exact support numerator or establish study-stock genome placement, formal nomenclatural changes, or new assembly evidence. The normalized Dataset S1 roster remains separate from raw supplement and genome validation. Native changes are limited to five blocks/statuses and two substantive inline events; fifteen processed descriptors do not mean fifteen changed statuses. Preserve the source root-diversity prose/caption discrepancy, absence of demonstrated facilitation or host-fitness benefit, lack of mechanistic flavonoid mediation, source-specific colonization and SRC1/SRC2v4 comparisons, and the limited strategy comparison; issue 1811 remains unresolved. The crosswalk hash identifies bytes, with no established upstream release or chronology. This partial technical diagnostic does not complete scientific review, source-snippet certification, generated products or aggregate QC.
